definitions.explanation: The main or central railway station in a city, typically the largest or most important station serving as the primary hub for train services. Used both as a general term and as part of specific station names.

examples.japanese: {中央駅|ちゅうおうえき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{降|お}りて→降りる：00568_oriru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please get off at the central station.

examples.japanese: {中央駅|ちゅうおうえき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改札|かいさつ}{口|ぐち}→改札口：09552_kaisatsuguchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせた→待ち合わせる：12328_machiawaseru⟧。
examples.english: We arranged to meet at the ticket gate of the central station.

examples.japanese: ⟦ヨーロッパ→ヨーロッパ：00427_yooroppa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「{中央駅|ちゅうおうえき}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{名付|なづ}けられた→名付ける：11998_nazukeru⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many European cities have large stations named 'Central Station.'

notes:
Composed of ⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧ (center, central) and ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧ (station). While Japan does not typically name stations this way (preferring city-name-based naming like {東京駅|とうきょうえき}), the term is commonly encountered when discussing foreign train stations or as a general descriptor. Some Japanese cities do have stations with ⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧ in the name, such as {千葉中央駅|ちばちゅうおうえき}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中央駅|ちゅうおうえき}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: in front of the central station
- {中央駅|ちゅうおうえき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{徒歩|とほ}→徒歩：03031_toho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: on foot from the central station
- {中央駅|ちゅうおうえき}⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧: the area around the central station

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {主要駅|しゅようえき}: main station — emphasizes importance rather than location
- ⟦{終着駅|しゅうちゃくえき}→終着駅：23879_shuuchakueki⟧: terminal station — the last stop on a line
- {乗換駅|のりかええき}: transfer station — a station for changing lines
